college.name: D. Y. Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi
college.subtitle: Approved by AICTE, New Delhi & Affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University
college.about: Established in 1984, DYPCOE offers premier undergraduate and postgraduate engineering programs fostering research, innovation, and ethical engineering education.
highlights: Modern Computing Labs, Centers of Excellence & High-Speed Wi-Fi

departments.name: Computer Engineering
departments.description: Focuses on computer architecture, software development, algorithms, web technologies, and cloud computing.
departments.labs: High Performance Computing Lab, Cloud Lab, Software Engineering Lab

departments.name: Information Technology
departments.description: Focuses on network administration, enterprise software development, database systems, and cybersecurity.
departments.labs: Network Security Lab, Database Lab, Mobile Application Lab

departments.name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
departments.description: Focuses on machine learning, deep learning, data visualization, predictive analytics, and natural language processing.
departments.labs: Deep Learning Studio, Big Data Lab, AI Innovation Hub

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.description: Focuses on machine design, thermodynamics, electric vehicle systems, robotics, and precision manufacturing.
departments.labs: CAD/CAM Simulation Center, Robotics Lab, Automobile Lab

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.description: Specializes in smart structural engineering, GIS survey, green building techniques, and transportation planning.
departments.labs: Concrete Technology Lab, Geotechnical Lab, Surveying Center

courses.title: Web Technology
courses.description: Covers semantic HTML5, CSS3 styling, client-side SPA routing, ES6 JavaScript, and JSON data integration.

courses.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
courses.description: Explores linear and non-linear data structures, searching and sorting algorithms, and algorithm complexity.

courses.title: Database Management Systems
courses.description: Relational database design, SQL query writing, normal forms, transaction management, and NoSQL.

courses.title: Cyber Security & Cryptography
courses.description: Information security principles, public key cryptography, network security protocols, and ethical hacking.

courses.title: Machine Learning Foundations
courses.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, decision trees, and model evaluation.

courses.title: Robotics & Automation
courses.description: Kinematics and dynamics of robotic arms, sensors, microcontrollers, and industrial automation.

courses.title: Structural Analysis
courses.description: Analysis of determinate and indeterminate structures, beams, frames, and load calculation methods.
